title: Install and maintain network security controls
text: Install and maintain network security controls to protect cardholder data. This includes firewalls, and configuration of network and network segmentation in alignment with the PCI DSS and best practices. Processes and mechanisms for installing and maintaining network security controls are defined and understood.

title: Apply secure configurations to all system components
text: Apply secure configurations to all system components, change vendor-supplied defaults, remove unnecessary functionality, and implement and maintain secure configurations. All system components are configured and managed to align with industry standards and vendor guidance.

title: Protect stored account data
text: Protect stored account data: keep cardholder data storage to a minimum, never store sensitive authentication data (SAD) after authorization, and render primary account numbers (PAN) unreadable by encrypting or otherwise protecting them wherever stored.

title: Protect cardholder data with strong cryptography during transmission
text: Protect cardholder data with strong cryptography during transmission over open, public networks, and protect the confidentiality and integrity of cardholder data when transmitted.

title: Protect all systems and networks from malicious software
text: Protect all systems and networks from malicious software: deploy anti-malware software on all system components except those identified in scoping exercises as not at risk, and ensure it is kept current and is evaluated at least annually as to its deployment and effectiveness.

title: Develop and maintain secure systems and software
text: Develop and maintain secure systems and software: address common coding vulnerabilities through training, review, and testing; protect against known vulnerabilities by installing applicable security patches; and follow an industry-recognized secure software development lifecycle.

title: Restrict access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know
text: Restrict access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know: provide access only to personnel whose roles require it, and implement and manage an access control model that denies all access unless specifically allowed.

title: Identify users and authenticate access to system components
text: Identify users and authenticate access to system components: assign a unique ID to each person and use strong authentication factors; support MFA for all non-console access into the CDE and remote access; manage credentials properly.

title: Restrict physical access to cardholder data
text: Restrict physical access to cardholder data: manage media, control access to devices, and protect the physical locations where cardholder data is processed, stored, or transmitted.

title: Log and monitor all access to system components and cardholder data
text: Log and monitor all access to system components and cardholder data: implement audit logs to record system component activity, protect logs, and review logs and other security events to detect anomalies and respond to incidents.

title: Test security of systems and networks regularly
text: Test security of systems and networks regularly: implement processes for vulnerability management and penetration testing, including internal and external vulnerability scans at least quarterly and annual internal and external penetration testing of network and application layers.

title: Support information security with organizational policies and programs
text: Support information security with organizational policies and programs: establish, publish, and maintain overall information security policy; assign roles and responsibilities; implement risk management, access management, training, and incident response programs; and evaluate third-party service providers.

title: Minimize stored account data
text: Limit the storage of cardholder data to that which is required for legal, regulatory, and business requirements, and define, implement, and maintain processes to securely delete stored account data when no longer needed.

title: Protect PANs with cryptography
text: Render primary account numbers (PAN) unreadable wherever stored by using cryptography, key management processes and procedures, and procedures for secure storage and deletion.

title: Multi-factor authentication
text: Use multi-factor authentication to secure access into the cardholder data environment, with MFA implemented for all non-console access into the CDE for personnel with administrative access, and for all remote network access originating from outside the entity's network.

title: Intrusion detection and prevention
text: Deploy automated mechanisms (e.g., IDPS) to detect, alert on, and block attacks on and from the cardholder data environment, and incorporate them into an entity's incident detection and response process.
